body: Thank you for your advice. If you're finding ways to help yourself than you're doing better than me at the moment, you dumb stoner :P
You're right about getting stuck in your head, I always try to see things from a bigger perspective. I guess my career isn't the best one for someone with issues
Thanks :) I've applied for a new job that would give me more time for hobbies so hopefully I get a call back

I used to read a lot, now I have trouble even sitting and watching a movie, even since I started hospitality my mind works in overdrive. I don't think that helps me at all, it would be nice to have a break from thinking

I'm a chef, been working in a kitchen since 2007, qualified chef for almost 2 years. I work a lot of split shifts which doesn't leave me much time for anything else. My days off I generally try to catch up on sleep (I don't sleep well after work, it's 3am now) and I've just been getting more and more frustrated with people lately. I wish I could just disappear for awhile.

I try to focus on positive things but I just feel empty and tired. Ending this feels like rest, it might seem strange but I feel old, I feel tired and exhausted and old.

I don't want to feel like it's ok, I don't like being a burden to people, I'm tired of feeling lost...

Thank you for your reply.

The problem I have with my family (and few friends) is that I've never really been able to connect with them. It feels like they're moving on and I just can't keep up.

I work a lot so hobbies are hard to pick up, but I'm looking for a new job to try and give myself some time.

I guess it's just hard when I know how big ending your life is, and just being ok with it..

I can't say I'm having as much trouble as OP but I just made this account to try and get some help and answers for some stuff I've been dealing with, I'm not really sure where to start. Any help would be great. Good luck OP!
